som.text: The Tangle is a metallic forest where the shadow of the Mephidross spreads and the vampires' territory expands, and where the troll Chunth abducts Glissa, saying it was to protect her.
The Viridians who live there reject the Tel-Jilad hierarchy and form voluntary brigades called gades, and under Ezuri they set out to destroy the myr, vedalken and anything unnatural.

With Phyrexia's advance the Tangle is infected by lamina fungus that rots the ground, and after the Phyrexians build nine layers on Mirrodin it is transplanted to the fourth layer as the Hunter's Maze.

nph.text: In New Phyrexia, Glissa builds a powerful faction by exploiting discontent, and before the main attack she sends enforcer-beasts to kill in the Tangle and sets up nodes of control, so the forest is firmly hers when Phyrexia emerges.
The Sylvok are hit hardest, with over half killed in the first wave, while Ezuri leads many Viridian elves into hiding and builds a small resistance in the treetops.

An infant named Melira is abandoned in the Tangle for her fully organic body and saved by the last troll, Thrun, who adopts her and realizes she is immune to the Spore and to phyresis, and may be the key to saving Mirrodin.
